reviewWhen: Owner-authorized storage capacity/retention/archiving controls are implemented and validated.
review: Add the actual fields, modest-hardware sizing workflow, no-automatic-expiry semantics, archive/restore procedure and limits. Preserve the distinction between database topology, backup and data retention.

reviewWhen: The accepted product provides the queued Historian storage/archiving administration controls.
review: Link and explain the actual storage controls without conflating acquisition admission, aggregation, retention or backup. Replace only obsolete limitations and keep acquisition examples verified.

reviewWhen: Accepted storage/archiving administration defines how Audit retention is exposed to users.
review: Recheck read-only diagnostics versus actual retention controls and link the verified administration procedure. Do not turn the current indicators into claimed editable controls without an implemented UI.

reviewWhen: The accepted Home/Building UI supplies explicit Home Assistant entity selection to the existing discovery contract.
review: Replace the empty-selection limitation with the verified selection/preview/apply procedure; verify empty, missing and selected entities, no whole-instance import and all locales.

reviewWhen: The accepted TAG assistant emits a canonical KNX/IP binding that is accepted by the unchanged strict Runtime planner.
review: Remove the incompatible-authoring limitation only after real assistant output, saved/reopened binding and planner acceptance are checked. Keep command/state separation and unsupported-field rejection in all locales.

reviewWhen: The accepted Home/Building flow forwards explicit IEEE selection and materializes only the selected Zigbee2MQTT devices.
review: Replace inventory-only limitation with verified selection/preview/apply steps. Check empty inventory-only discovery, missing IEEE, identity metadata and all locales.

reviewWhen: The accepted TAG assistant emits a Native Zigbee binding with identity in PortableAddress and no duplicated Settings.
review: Review the creation limitation only after actual assistant output, persistence and strict Runtime planner admission are verified in all locales. Retain network/host provisioning and onOff-only scope.

reviewWhen: The accepted TAG assistant can create the required typed Z-Wave binding even when the descriptor has no extra fields.
review: Replace new-binding authoring limitation after component/persistence/planner verification. Preserve typed property/key identity, persistent-value scope and externally commissioned-network prerequisites.

reviewWhen: The accepted decoder and provider/Runtime paths consume the published nested definition.exposes inventory.
review: Replace the format incompatibility limitation after testing the exact external example and preserving source/IEEE/endpoint/property identity, selection and bounds. Update documentation-characterization tests and all locales; closing the issue alone is insufficient.

reviewWhen: The actual catalog and assistant emit the S7 binding schema and project ordering into the shared physical transform, without legacy order settings or address tokens.
review: Replace the creation limitation only after real assistant output, save/reopen and strict planner acceptance are checked. Update the characterization test and all three locales; do not instruct users to invent schema IDs.

reviewWhen: The actual assistant projects Logix symbolic fields into PortableAddress, leaves Settings empty and projects integer bits into the shared selector.
review: Review the creation limitation only after component output, persistence and strict planner admission are proven, including native-type, bit-width and read-only restrictions in all locales.

reviewWhen: An accepted graphical authoring flow emits and persists the required explicit Matter binding despite its current empty point-field schema.
review: Replace the incomplete-authoring limitation only after real component output passes the strict planner and survives reopening. Address text and host-key provisioning alone do not create the binding; review all locales and screenshots.

reviewWhen: The Product Owner accepts physical placement and recovery in Preview and confirms that the E2E captures match the accepted interface; replace them if the Preview differs.
review: Verify the profile fields, 1–4 windows, navigation/fixed behavior, blocked-popup fallback, per-window session result and close/reopen/reconnect instructions against the accepted Preview. The current manual images are real captures from the product UI in a CI E2E run; compare them with Preview and replace them if any visible difference exists. Keep manual physical placement and lack of automatic monitor-position restoration explicit unless the product changes.
